Bestiář používá pevné schválené statblok: The Bestiary uses fixed, approved stat blocks. During an encounter, Vaelor must not arbitrarily change HP, attack, defence, abilities or weaknesses. XP is awarded for fully overcoming an obstacle, rather than for killing. A boss has no hidden HP multiplier, extra actions or other hidden bonuses. Players' strong/weak attributes, magic and starting equipment follow the final Manual, Spell Book and Equipment Catalogue; the Bestiary no longer duplicates their old working test versions.

Boss nemá automaticky více akcí za kolo,: A boss does not automatically receive more actions per round, an HP multiplier, roll bonuses or immunity to players' abilities. Such an effect applies only if explicitly stated in its statistics. During an encounter, Vaelor must not arbitrarily change a boss's HP, attack, defence, abilities or weaknesses to prolong combat or alter its outcome. If a clever plan lets the players resolve the boss very quickly, that result stands. The same base XP is awarded for fully overcoming the boss through combat, capture, deception, persuasion, expulsion or another genuine resolution of the main obstacle.
XP představuje odměnu za úplné překonání: XP rewards fully overcoming an opponent or obstacle, rather than killing. Defeat, capture, deception, surrender, expulsion or another complete resolution awards the same base XP. Individual opponents' XP is normally added together and is not divided among active party members. Merely bypassing an obstacle without resolving it need not award full XP. Vaelor does not reward artificially farming easy opponents.

Kategorie silné/slabé vlastnosti je urče: The final Manual determines which attributes are strong or weak. Classes add attribute points but do not change the strong/weak classification; a Human chooses one strong and one weak attribute during creation.
PDEF = AGI + adjusted armour bonus + LB.
FO = ⌈2O/3⌉ + upravený bonus zbroje + up: PDEF = ⌈2AGI/3⌉ + adjusted armour bonus + adjusted shield bonus + ⌈STR/4⌉ + LB.
MÚ = CH + upravený bonus kouzla + BŠ. Hr: MATK = INT + adjusted spell bonus + LB. Player spells use the final Spell Book coefficients and rules; the Bestiary no longer treats the working test version +0/+3 as a rule.
MO = CH + BŠ + bonus magické ochrany. Da: MDEF = INT + LB + magical protection bonus. Further final rules for magical defence bonuses follow the Spell Book and Equipment Catalogue.
Je definitivně řešeno v Katalogu vybaven: Fully defined in the Equipment Catalogue. The final Bestiary does not duplicate old test starting loadouts.
U všech existujících položek jsou schvál: For all existing entries, the approved STR/AGI/INT/CHA/LUCK, HP, PATK, PDEF, MATK, MDEF, abilities, XP and difficulty values are binding. Standard stat blocks are not recalculated using old working tests.
Vaelor najde nejbližší referenční bestii: Vaelor finds the closest reference creature, uses its mathematical basis, changes only characteristic attributes and creates at most 1–2 new abilities. New creatures are listed in the adventure's closing summary.
9 základních bossů je závazná referenční: The 9 basic bosses form a binding reference set. No hidden HP multipliers, extra actions, roll bonuses or immunities.
XP je za úplné překonání překážky, nikol: XP rewards fully overcoming an obstacle rather than killing; it is not divided among active party members; artificial farming is not rewarded.
Ze staré pracovní verze byly odstraněny: Only non-binding analytical sheets and notes based on outdated assumptions were removed from the old working version (test spell +0/+3, test starting equipment, old player reference matrix and development changelogs). No approved statistic, XP value, recommended opponent count, defensive specialisation or boss was changed.
